search_window.basis: Begins at the independently verified completed_at of preceding Food Line watch ledger heartbeat; requires newly published or newly effective direct access disruption within this bounded interval, not historical reposts.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall check for four audited miss classes; production nationwide collection is authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/fire/disaster closure of only, sole, last or full-service community grocery
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended for disaster/weather/outage/facility damage
Abrupt pantry or food bank shutdown or major reduction in food access
New official SNAP, WIC or food assistance benefit/system interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.search_engine: web fast; recency 1 day, targeted to Nov 9 2026
search_queries: November 9 2026 "only grocery store" closed fire town
November 9 2026 mobile pantry cancellation power outage
November 9 2026 food bank temporarily closes distribution services fire
November 9 2026 pantry service suspended suddenly building damage
November 9 2026 SNAP EBT benefits outage delayed state department notice
November 9 2026 WIC EBT systems down suspension benefits official
November 9 2026 official agency emergency food assistance benefits interruption inaccessible

failures.error: Source returned internal error/inaccessible to web fetch; no new federal notice could be independently verified at this endpoint.

freshness_limits: Dare to Care /today/ direct fetch returned an October 8 2026 calendar snapshot despite November 9 search index; not evidence of current November 9 service status.
Hawaiʻi SNAP agency page describes previously documented call-center delays without a November 9 timestamp.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Spencer, NY sole grocery fire occurred September 11, 2026; historical duplicate.
El Paso food bank storm closure dates to September 25, 2026; not in window.
Alabama storm-related food distribution cancellation dated October 7, 2026; historical.
Santa Clarita Valley pantry strike closure dated January 27, 2026; historical.
Homedale pantry closure reported November 24, 2025; historical.
Virginia social service offices listed closures on November 5-6 with scheduled reopening November 9 8 a.m.; not a newly announced in-window SNAP/WIC benefit interruption.
Standing application and phone delay notice without an in-window dated new event.
Latest indexed Hurricane Lowell emergency food coverage remained November 6; scheduled distributions, not canceled in-window.
Provider schedule contains ordinary distribution listings, no newly verified in-window cancellations.
CalFresh general information and older hot topics; no newly documented immediate-access interruption.

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Omit fundraising, routine distributions and resource listings, opinion, generic inflation, program promotion, historical/duplicated reports, and non-U.S. locations.
coverage_notes.assessment: Twelve targeted searches returned usable results and seven of eight direct-source page checks were accessible. None substantiated a newly reported qualifying U.S. food-access disruption since the last verified heartbeat. The single USDA page access failure limits that endpoint but does not materially impair supplementary coverage; the absence of a finding is not evidence of comprehensive nationwide absence.
